request.style: English, Delta blues, raw male vocal, resonator slide guitar, stomp box, harmonica, sparse and haunting, 70 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Two brothers working the morning land
One with the flock and one with the plough in his hand
Abel brought the firstborn and the best of what he had
Cain brought his offering and his heart was turning bad

[Verse]
Sin was crouching at the door like a hungry dog
Cain let it in and the evening turned to fog
Out in the field where nobody could see
He rose up against his brother by the old fig tree

[Chorus]
Where is your brother Abel
I do not know
Am I my brother's keeper
Am I my brother's keeper

[Verse]
What have you done
Listen, your brother's blood is crying out to me from the ground
Cain went out wandering, the earth no longer his
But God put a mark on him, that's how mercy is

[Chorus]
Where is your brother Abel
I do not know
Am I my brother's keeper
Am I my brother's keeper

[Outro]
Yes, I am my brother's keeper
Lord, make me my brother's keeper
